verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim hardware plugin support for Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, Rebellions NPU, Apple Silicon, and MetaX GPU via a plugin architecture, directly matching the story. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence corroborating TPU/Gaudi inference in practice, and community evidence focuses only on GPU-based usage. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of TPU or Gaudi usage, details on plugin setup/limitations, and any hands-on report of performance on these accelerators.
